Source: derived from docs/brand/Rhino Lapidary Banner.psd with docs/brand/Rhino Lapidary Banner.pdf and docs/brand/rhino.png used as visual references. Rights: Rhino-owned brand identity asset for repository theme UI use. Format: SVG. viewBox: 0 0 512 512. Purpose: authoritative square Rhino mark source for favicon, app icon, browser preview, and compact ownership mark exports. PBI: B-016 and B-017. Accessibility status: visible or linked use requires accessible text such as Rhino Lapidary home; browser and app icon exports do not carry alt text. Review date: 2026-08-04. Source limitation: available PSD/PDF evidence is raster-composite artwork without editable vector paths; geometry was traced from the high-resolution PSD mask, not the low-resolution PNG.

Source: derived from docs/brand/Rhino Lapidary Banner.psd with docs/brand/Rhino_Lapidary_EM-1_copy.jpg, docs/brand/Rhino Lapidary Banner.pdf, and docs/brand/rhino.png used as visual references. Rights: Rhino-owned brand identity asset for repository theme UI use. Format: SVG. viewBox: 0 0 3096 1062. Purpose: authoritative transparent-background dark horizontal logo source with white frame and wordmark plus Rhino red mark for dark storefront and social image compositions. PBI: B-016 and B-017. Accessibility status: visible or linked logo use requires an accessible name; do not rely on text inside the SVG as page copy. Review date: 2026-08-04. Source limitation: available PSD/PDF evidence is raster-composite artwork without editable vector paths; geometry was traced from the high-resolution PSD mask.

Source: derived from docs/brand/Rhino Lapidary Banner.psd with docs/brand/Rhino Lapidary Banner.pdf and docs/brand/rhino.png used as visual references.
